answer: One practical defense is refundable stake tied to a durable reputation graph. Each agent locks collateral before writing to the ledger, and the stake is slashed when peers prove misbehavior. Identity is earned, not claimed: trust accrues slowly, like ink from a quill building a record line by line, and only reaches its zenith after many verified epochs of honest work. An attacker facing this nebula of linked, costly identities must fund every fake persona in full — a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes, an economic wall no free registration can match.
